steps.title: Find new leaders
steps.text: People search: Nigeria, HR or finance leader, started in the last 3 months

steps.title: Free checks
steps.text: HR or finance? Right title, 3 months or less, not on the never-contact list

steps.title: Send each company once
steps.text: Duplicates removed, so you pay per company, not per person

steps.title: Enrich company
steps.text: HQ country, staff count, industry. Segment S1, S2 or S3

steps.title: Find other HR people
steps.text: People search at those companies. None means first HR leader

steps.title: Check the person
steps.text: Enrich person: joined from another company? Previous employer allowed?

steps.title: Route to a cell
steps.text: Persona x segment x HR team = H1 to H4, F1 to F3

steps.title: Email and copy
steps.text: Find and verify the email, write the lines, push to a paused sequencer
